questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Jaya said that she will become topper in her class.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is:** she will become topper**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The article **"the"** is used to specify a **particular noun**.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Some / private banks / pay their employees / good.
questions.solution:

• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the adjective 'good' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, 'good' should be replaced with 'well' to correctly modify the verb 'pay'.
 
• Adjectives modify nouns, whereas **adverbs** modify **verbs**, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
 
• **Example:** *The bank pays well.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the adverb 'well' should be used in place of the adjective 'good'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Some private banks pay their employees **well**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Adjectives are used to describe or modify nouns and pronouns.
 
 
• **Example:** *She is a good dancer.*
 
 
 
• Adverbs are used to describe or modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
 
• Example: *She dances well.*
